reasoning:
The claim that "Generative AI will replace 300 million jobs worldwide" is a misleading oversimplification of a widely cited March 2023 report by Goldman Sachs. 

The actual report estimated that generative AI could "expose" the equivalent of 300 million full-time jobs globally to automation, not that it would outright replace them or eliminate those workers. "Exposure" to automation means that a portion of the tasks associated with those jobs could be automated. The report specifically notes that most jobs and industries are only partially exposed to automation and are therefore more likely to be complemented rather than substituted by AI. Furthermore, historical trends suggest that technological displacement is offset by the creation of new employment opportunities and increased productivity. Representing this figure as definitive, total job replacement is incorrect and exaggerates the report's actual economic projections.
title: Generative AI will replace 300 million jobs
